content: Splitwise keeps balances separate per currency by default (e.g. 'you owe $12.45 and are owed £8.72') rather than force-converting to one currency — avoids FX-rate ambiguity and staleness. Some competitors (Splitsies, My Finance Tools) optionally layer live conversion for a single blended total, but that is an added feature on top of, not a replacement for, per-currency balances. This directly supports the project's locked decision (per-expense currency, no group-wide currency): displaying a set of per-currency net balances per member pair is the standard, expected approach; currency conversion/aggregation is an enhancement to defer.
